title: Neon Film Reel
description: In a gritty underground bunker illuminated by a yellow fluorescent tube and purple neon sign reading 'FEATURE REEL', a woman in a yellow futuristic jumpsuit stands on concrete steps holding a large film reel on her back while looking at a large glowing movie poster of herself holding a gun.
prompt: A cyberpunk scene inside a dirty concrete bunker with peeling posters and hazard tape. A woman in a tight yellow futuristic jumpsuit with tech gear stands on concrete stairs, holding a large film reel on her back, looking at a large illuminated movie poster of herself in an action pose holding a pistol. The poster has a glowing green grid floor. A pink neon sign reads 'FEATURE REEL'. Dim yellow fluorescent lighting, scattered bottles and cables on the floor, cinematic atmosphere.
